The design is fixed and all tests pass (`TEST PASSED`).

Bugs fixed in `rtl/uart_tx.v`:
1. Reset drove `tx <= 1'b0` instead of `1'b1`, violating the idle-high requirement.
2. `data_r` was captured on any `tx_start` pulse, even while `busy = 1`, violating the spec requirement that `tx_start`/`tx_data` be ignored during an in-progress frame. Gated the capture with `state == S_IDLE`.
